value.message: Oakville's Learn to Swim has two preschool options for 3-5 year olds (no parent needed): Preschool A Saturdays 9:00-9:30 and Preschool B Saturdays 9:40-10:10, both Sept 12 to Nov 28 - their site says. I couldn't pin down the price. Fall registration opens Tuesday, Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you when the price posts.
